description: Generates a formal, payer-ready prior-authorization / medical-necessity letter for a procedure, merging supplied patient and clinical details with the procedure’s CPT codes, recommended primary ICD-10 code, evidence grade, and necessity rationale. Any field left unspecified is rendered as a clearly-marked fill-in blank. The structured medical-necessity worksheet is appended when available. PREMIUM tier.

conservativeCare.description: Failed conservative care with durations, e.g. "8 weeks PT, NSAIDs x6 weeks".

icd10.description: Primary ICD-10 code; defaults to the recommended primary code.

includeWorksheet.description: Append the structured medical-necessity worksheet template (default true).

painScore.description: Pain score, e.g. "7/10 at rest, 9/10 with activity".

procedure.description: Procedure name, id, or CPT code.

name: get_prior_auth_letter
title: Generate Prior Authorization Letter
